proof_summary: At \(n=473165\), the intermediate value \(a(n)+4=5292270077783\) lies strictly between the proposed pair. It is itself a Sierpiński number: a period-48 covering congruence using \(\{3,5,7,17,97,257,673\}\) gives a proper divisor of \(5292270077783\cdot2^m+1\) for every positive exponent \(m\), so the pair is not consecutive.
